messages:
Ethan: FYI — Embroider (AE-led POC) wants to validate a new model variant on our infra. They called it "scarlet-v2-q4" and want to test both hosted and a short dedicated pool for the POC. Asking: compatibility, latency SLOs (≤150ms p50 for 512 tokens), and any security gating we should flag.
Priya: quick q — what's their expected RPS and typical prompt length distribution? Also do they expect KV cache/prefix reuse?
Ethan: RPS ~20 spike to 60 during demo. Prompts average 100–700 tokens, often long context ~4k in some threads. They want prefix caching for chat history reuse.
Lina: scarlet-v2-q4 is a Q4 quantized variant, right? We need to run the quant-compat matrix. Main caveat: some Q4 kernels haven't been validated for >2048 KV spans on A100 older drivers — might see memory fragmentation. For 4k contexts we should test on our dedicated config with 80GB GPU or enable sharded KV.
Priya: noted. For latency target 150ms p50 at 512 tokens that's tight on q4 with 4k context unless batching small and pinning to low-latency nodes. If they go dedicated with 2 GPUs (A100-80) and continuous batching disabled for demo, should be reachable. I'll draft a perf run plan.
Marco: security side — need to confirm model license & provenance (copy of model card + license). Also Embroider wants VPC-only for POC data; they asked about KMS for keys. We'll need SOC2 proof + any contractual restrictions on storing model weights. If scarlet is from a third party we must validate redistribution terms.
Ethan: they said model was trained by a partner and they have a redistributable enterprise license. I'll get the docs.
Priya: perf run plan (short):
```
- baseline n=50 runs @1 RPS single client
- seq lens: 128/512/1024/4096
- mode: hosted + dedicated template: ded-small-2gpus
- enable kv_cache metrics + mem prof
```
Priya: Also suggest trying the hybrid route: hosted inference for initial demo (fast setup) + a Dedicated short-term reservation for the stress test. Pricing for dedicated short-term: we can do a 30-day promo rate for POCs — Ethan, would you like me to get a quote for 2x A100-80 for 30 days?
Ethan: yes please. Also they asked for per-token cost estimate if they stay hosted after POC (higher precision variant vs q4). Can you give a rough delta?
Priya: rough numbers: q4 ~0.6x hosted cost vs fp16 baseline for token compute, but you pay for memory and throughput differences. If they move to fp16 the latency per token rises but cost goes up ~1.6x. I can pull a sample calc once I know avg tokens/day.
Lina: ops note — enable KV eviction policy to avoid OOM in demo. Add env flag in deployment: `KV_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES=200000` and `SHARD_KV=true` for the dedicated job.
Ethan: sending model license and sample corpus now. Also they have a security questionnaire (SSQ) with some infrastructure questions — Marco can you triage the SSQ items related to model handling and keys?
Marco: yeh I will. Please drop the SSQ as a PDF in the channel. Quick hits: we need to answer data retention, key rotation policy, on-prem options, and whether we log raw inputs. We can say we support redaction and configurable logging.
Ethan: uploaded: https://files.redwood/embroider/scarlet-license.pdf and SSQ attached.
deploy-bot: Deployment template `ded-small-2gpus` exists in infra-templates. To run perf: `rb deploy start --template ded-small-2gpus --env POC-embroider --model scarlet-v2-q4` (this will spin a short-lived pool).
Priya: I'll schedule perf runs tomorrow morning (09:00 PT). Lina — can you reserve the cluster for 09:00-12:00 and capture GPU mem + kv metrics? Add tracing tags `embroider-poc`.
Lina: reserved the cluster and enabled metrics. I'll attach the perf logs to this thread after run.
Ethan: thanks all. One blocker from client: they want contractual confirmation we won't use their data to fine-tune other customers' models. Marco — is that standard in enterprise POC addendum?
Marco: yes we can add a clause: no derivative training on customer data, and we can provide an isolation addendum. I'll draft and loop legal.
Ethan: perfect. Anything else? :thumbsup:
Priya: if perf looks good I'll prepare a short ops playbook for the AE demo (warmup commands, recommended payloads, abort steps). Will post in channel.
Lina: perf logs will be here ~noon PT.
Ethan: great — keep me posted. :rocket:
